author: Twillion
description: Advanced diffuse BRDF material control for 3D objects. v3.2: Patches Three.js shader at runtime by safely replacing BRDF_Lambert calls inside RE_Direct_Physical with a custom dispatcher. Robust to Three.js version changes. Retains GDevelop lights, shadows, PBR specular, normal maps, and all built-in 3D features. v3.2: Adds 7 diffuse models (half-lambert, wrap, lommel-seeliger, velvet/sheen, ashikhmin-shirley, fresnel-diffuse, kajiya-kay) and a CurrentBRDFIndex numeric expression.
name: BRDFMaterials
shortDescription: Diffuse BRDF shaders (Lambert, Burley, Oren-Nayar, Minnaert, Toon, Callisto, Half-Lambert, Wrap, Lommel-Seeliger, Velvet, Ashikhmin-Shirley, Fresnel-diffuse, Kajiya-Kay) for 3D objects.

eventsBasedBehaviors.description: Applies a custom diffuse BRDF (Lambert, Burley, Oren-Nayar, Minnaert, Toon, Callisto) to 3D objects via onBeforeCompile. Patches Three.js MeshStandard/Physical material's BRDF_Lambert call at runtime, preserving all GDevelop lights, shadows, and PBR specular.
eventsBasedBehaviors.name: BRDFMaterial
